purpose: Does each Dorar button open the same hadith entry the platform cites?
method: For every grade of every record, the Dorar search results (first six words, then full text; up to 12 pages, both result tabs) were read in the Claude desktop built-in browser and the entry whose muhaddith, book and page/number equal the platform's grade was taken; its own page (https://dorar.net/h/…) was then opened and its muhaddith, book and number read back.

summary.grade_text_differences: none except editorial brackets on one ruling (sahihjami-3289, الذهبي: «[فيه] … [و] …»)

ui_rule: «فتح النتيجة في الدرر السنية» only for a dorar.net/h/ entry link; «فتح الحديث المشابه في الدرر السنية» when the entry is a similar text; otherwise «البحث عن النص في الدرر السنية».
previous_check_superseded: The earlier note (first search result only) is replaced by this entry-level check.
